game_abilities.title_en: At 5 hits Drift gains his Focus and gains a Precision Buff that increases Crit Chance by {{var_1}} and decreases the opponent’s chance to Evade (by {{var_2}}) until hit next by the opponent.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 击中 5 次时，漂移获得专注并获得精确增益，使暴击率增加 {{var_1}}，并减少对手躲避的机会（通过 {{var_2}}），直到被对手击中。

game_abilities.title_en: At 10 hits Drift’s Focus improves and grants him a {{var_3}} Crit Damage Buff in addition to his Precision Buff until hit next by the opponent.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 击中 10 次时，漂移的专注度会提高，除了精准增益之外，他还会获得 {{var_3}} 暴击伤害增益，直到对手下一次击中。
近战与远程攻击出暴击时，有65%的概率造成攻击力30%的流血伤害，持续2秒。

game_abilities.title_en: {{var_7}} chance to Evade attacks from Bleeding opponents.
game_abilities.desc_zh: {{var_7}} 有机会躲避流血对手的攻击。

game_abilities.title_en: Drift becomes {{var_8}} more evasive for each active Focus Buff.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 对于每个活跃的焦点增益，漂移变得更加难以躲避。

game_abilities.title_en: Drift has a {{var_9}} chance to regain his focus Precision Buff.
game_abilities.desc_zh: Drift 有 {{var_9}} 机会重新获得专注精准增益。
